answer: Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The vertex lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pulse is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
